name: Caterpillar - Clayton NC Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (BCP - small wheel loader assembly)

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (35.6405,-78.4243) is ROOFTOP and lands on the Caterpillar Clayton plant. Locked the main building center at 35.6405,-78.4248. Confirmed: large single manufacturing building with rows of finished yellow Caterpillar small wheel loaders staged in the yard - directly confirms the BCP small-wheel-loader assembly plant at 954 NC-42 E. The Rapp Customer & Training Center is the separate distinctive-roof building on the SW of the campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck access via a long entrance driveway off NC-42 E (confirmed in Street View) running back to the plant; product-staging yards and dock aprons are reached through internal roads. The property is buffered from NC-42 by woods; controlled access via the internal entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth resolvable from the public road - the driveway leads back into the property and the checkpoint is internal. Classified remoteGs (controlled internal gate, no road-visible booth); low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance driveway off NC-42 runs a long distance through woods before reaching the plant - ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive product-staging and material-laydown yards north and east of the building, full of finished small wheel loaders and components; trailers backed in along the east face and a curved trailer row in the north yard - drop capacity ~40.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~16 dock doors estimated along the east building face (trailers backed in); partly obscured by staged equipment - low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main assembly plant plus the separate Rapp Customer & Training Center and an ancillary building on the same campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property identified.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the plant sits among woods and farmland on the edge of Clayton with a treed buffer; classified Rural per the edge-of-town rule.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~130 acres for the plant campus including staging yards and parking - approximate.
